declaration.population_description: Synthetic design records supplied as the complete declared RDF-class population in each input. External legal/application eligibility and experimental edition selection are caller research assumptions, not inferred RDF facts or real-vessel certification. Records may be incomplete, inconsistent or contain unrecognized values. Conditions within the represented requirement, missing represented inputs, activation, datatype/unit/path and logical correctness remain for generated SHACL to assess. Evaluation covers finite represented inventories, not reconstruction of unrecorded real-world persons/components; this does not authorize inventing existence requirements or treating a represented missing value as compliant. Edition/application records described by section 1.1 of the retained text. Recorded construction date and provision/edition assertions are values to assess; this declaration does not assume that a date/edition assignment is correct or that every record belongs to the 2021 date interval.
